svg.title: City corridor: three regions of eighteen Support
svg.desc: Cities cluster at the western end. The Centre sits at the junction of a long mixed southern corridor and an expansive outlying region. Shared border segments define adjacency; corners do not. Bellweather Centre borders all three regions.
svg.text: Urban: 18 / 9 votes Mixed: 18 / 9 votes Outlying: 18 / 9 votes Centre: 3 separate Support
Circles = Support spaces. Heavy lines = region borders. Thin lines = district borders.
Concept only · District elections remain local · Territory size does not indicate capacity
